newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet dips with NYMEX, differentials mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet dips with NYMEX, differentials mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell with NYMEX futures Tuesday, players said, with differentials mixed on aviation-quality 54-grade fuel but firming about one cent on low-sulfur 55-grade amid demand for blending.

New York Harbor 54-grade was talked about 3.0 cents over December futures, 0.25 cent firmer than Monday diffs, while Gulf Coast material weakened a smidgen to about 0.75 cent below the print, traders said.
NYH and Gulf Coast 55-grade saw diffs firm as much as one cent, to 4.0 cents over and 1.50 cents over, respectively.

"Some surplus 55-grade has been bought up for blending," one New York Harbor trader said, echoing market talk that many low-sulfur barrels were being used to turn Russian gas oil into higher grade heating oil.
